metadata.title: Retro New Wave Album Cover Aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly angled portrait of a bald man wearing opaque aviator sunglasses, framed by a thick cyan border with bold, heavy slab-serif typography in the upper-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The cyan border contains and compresses the central portrait.
The heavy white typography balances the visual weight of the subject's head.
The opaque, flat grey lenses of the sunglasses contrast with the textured skin and chest hair.
The dark, moody background creates a silhouette effect for the light-colored clothing.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but tilted slightly to the right, occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The opaque grey sunglasses act as the primary focal point due to their flat, unnatural texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text in the top left, move down the tilt of the head to the sunglasses, and follow the line of the jacket downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, out-of-focus background provides negative space that emphasizes the subject's contours.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border versus muted, grainy tones in the photographic subject.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Slightly rounded corners on the outer edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Z' has heavy horizontal bars and a thick diagonal.
The 'W' features overlapping or very tight central junctions.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for maximum impact; no secondary type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab structure and geometric feel.
Captures the rounded, heavy 70s/80s display aesthetic.
Provides the necessary blocky serif impact.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, 1980s-style portrait of a bald man with a light-colored jacket against a dark, blurry night background. Add a thick cyan border around the entire image. Place opaque, flat grey aviator sunglasses on the man's face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in the top-left corner using an extra-bold slab serif font in white.

verificationChecks: Is the border a solid, vibrant cyan?
Are the sunglasses completely opaque with no reflection?
Is the font heavy enough to command attention?
Does the image have a visible film grain texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness

mustAchieve: Flat graphic elements over photographic base

postGenerationChecks: Verify the cyan border is uniform in width.
Ensure the sunglasses look like a graphic overlay rather than realistic glass.
Check that the text is legible against the dark background.
Confirm the overall composition feels like a vintage vinyl record sleeve.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Opaque Eyewear + Thick Color Border + Heavy Slab Serif = Retro New Wave Aesthetic
